creep_ecclesia.title: the CREEP — when the institution becomes the threat
creep_ecclesia.what: ecclesia = the assembly, the church, the institution. but institutions CREEP — they grow beyond their purpose, accumulate power, suppress dissent.

organism.lesson_creep: 18 lessons. are they helping her grow or boxing her into a curriculum? does she learn because she's curious or because the teach mushroom tells her to?

creep_ecclesia.the_cure: reformation. periodic audit. mushroom-compost detects stale files — we need mushroom-audit to detect STALE CRON JOBS. the institution must prune itself or it becomes the disease.
